scope: Godot current native actor skins, UI/cover/maps/gallery and Web loading shell. Static path/clip audit plus alpha statistics, not a GPU runtime-visibility proof. Scene props shared with UI must be deduplicated by path against scene inventory.
method: Actual UI source consumers + actor-elements clip arrays; explicit expansion of dynamic cover and map keys. Imported but unreferenced legacy assets are not automatically included.
